editorial.blurb: A beloved hole-in-the-wall Chinese spot in Phoenix where fresh, generously portioned dishes and warm service keep locals coming back.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the roasted duck and orange chicken—reviewers rave about both—and expect your food to take a little time since everything is cooked to order.

topDishes.note: Fresh and incredible, a standout that even skeptical diners praised
Exceptional—described as the best roasted duck reviewers have tried
Amazing with full flavor and generous portions
